policy: Pinned upstream sources define generated native project contracts. The CommonLibSSE-NG commit here must equal the commonlibsse_ng pin in SDK-LOCK.json. Update only after source review and a real build of a scaffolded plugin.

commonlibsse_ng.consumption: add_subdirectory of the pinned SDK vault checkout via COMMONLIBSSE_NG_ROOT; the add_commonlibsse_plugin helper is included explicitly because a source build does not define it
locked_claims: add_commonlibsse_plugin creates the shared library and injects SKSE plugin declarations.
Address Library/signature scanning cannot be combined with explicit compatible runtimes.
Explicit runtime lists support at most 16 versions.
STRUCT_DEPENDENT changes the plugin declaration and must be opted into only when evidence requires it.
SKSEPluginLoad must initialize SKSE before accessing interfaces.
Data-dependent registration is delayed until kDataLoaded.

Upstream builds every dependency with the x64-windows-static-md triplet (static libraries, dynamic CRT) for both host and target; the default x64-windows triplet would make a plugin depend on loose DLLs.
Source builds need spdlog, rapidcsv and directxtk from vcpkg and fetch MinHook v1.3.4 (hde64) at configure time while SKSE_SUPPORT_PATCH_SAFETY is on.
The dependency list above equals the upstream vcpkg.json at the pinned commit, minus the host-only vcpkg-cmake-config and the Catch2 test feature.

superseded_lineage.reason: Unmaintained since 2024-09; upstream documents the vcpkg and Conan routes as not maintained. Forge 6.3.x scaffolds resolved this lineage; audit now warns when a project still does.

evidence_limits: A successful build is not evidence of SKSE loadability.
A PE audit is not evidence of runtime compatibility or hook coexistence.
Every release DLL requires an actual target-runtime launch and log/crash review.
